feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 September 2026 11:16am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 13 September 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Flat ridge of high pressure is slowly eroded from the southwest by an approaching frontal system.


##Wind##

Variable, becoming south or southeast this evening, 2 to 4, veering south or southwest 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then patchy rain or drizzle overnight with areas of mist and isolated fog patches.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor overnight and occasionally very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 to 5, increasing 5 or 6 through the evening and occasionally 7 in places, settling west or southwest 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, perhaps rough in the east at times.


##Weather##

Occasional rain as well as a risk of areas of mist and isolated fog patches. This all clearing to isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor or very poor in rain/mist/fog. Becoming mainly good later.
